description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of reference answers and test cases within a dataset. There are three categories represented in the chart: "Null" with 549,238 entries, "Have reference answer" with 543,935 entries, and "Have test case" with 306,818 entries. The "Null" category is the largest, occupying approximately 39.2% of the chart, followed closely by the "Have reference answer" category at about 38.9%. The "Have test case" category is the smallest, making up roughly 21.9% of the chart. Each slice is color-coded with "Null" in light red, "Have reference answer" in light blue, and "Have test case" in light green. The chart includes a legend in the upper left corner, which correlates the colors to the respective categories. The percentages are displayed inside the corresponding slices, and the chart is designed with a circular shape to accurately represent the proportions of each category.
